visual_name: Day in the life, part thirty seven: mostly the dog (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js tennis court (blue court with white lines, a net, a see-through fence, trees, a courtside bench), a ball machine that fires the brand's voice notes at her as tennis balls (one oversized for the seven-minute note) and then a barrage that knocks her flat, box-built tennis creator with a green visor, blonde ponytail, polo, pleated skirt and racket, phone sheets for voice notes / scrolling four hundred messages to 'This message was deleted' / a campaign agreement read, signed with a self-drawing signature and countersigned / the campaign with its agreement / an eleven-minute voice note and a dog, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.9 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: on a tennis court, the deal was in a voice note: three videos, he said. Then a second voice note: five videos? Then a third, seven minutes, about his dog. She scrolls up four hundred messages for proof; he'd deleted it, and the ball machine knocks her flat. Then YourBrand: the deal is one agreement in the app; she reads it, signs it, it gets countersigned, every term in writing in the campaign. The brand still sends voice notes. Mostly the dog.
